summary: Nine metres of kerb at a junction and school zone; too short and exposed.

best_section.where: west kerb of Central Avenue just below the junction, above the school-zone hump

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 9 m away at the south end; next homes 18 m away, with a mapped dwelling-lined street all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; the stretch is about one van length and sits at a junction mouth, so room is doubtful.
drivers.traffic: Junction with a school-zone speed hump immediately south.
drivers.convention: Two cyan signs mark 1/2P parking, 9am-4pm weekdays and Saturday mornings; one car is parked here.

flags: Half-hour parking signs on this stretch
sun_shade: Open; trees on the west verge give some morning shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the junction mouth leaves legal room
